description: Release state follows the linked Change. Re-read this table on every Change state or approval update, including when the Change moves backwards.
testCases: Authorize with approval requested / not requested / rejected / blank → Awaiting Approval
Approval state (same as Authorize, still waiting) → Awaiting Approval
Authorize after the Change is approved → Approved
Approval state after the Change is approved → Approved
ServiceNow numeric values (-5 New, -3 Authorize, …) resolve the same as labels
Forward path: New → Assess → Authorize (pending) → Authorize (approved) → Scheduled → Implement → Review → Closed
Backward path: Scheduled → Authorize (pending) moves Release Scheduled → Awaiting Approval
Backward path: Authorize → Assess moves Release → Draft
Canceled from any point moves Release to Cancelled
Unknown Change state leaves the Release where it is
No write when the Release is already on the mapped state
